title: Synergistic Effects of Radiotherapy and Immunotherapy in Gastrointestinal Malignancies: Biological Rationale, Clinical Evidence, and Future Directions.
snippet: Gastrointestinal (GI) cancers rank among the most common and lethal malignancies, and most are immunologically "cold," showing limited baseline sensitivity to immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs). Radiotherapy (RT) can boost antitumor immune responses and may convert some of these tumors into more treatment-responsive forms. This gives RT-ICI combinations a....
